title: Creamy Corn Casserole
description: A classic American casserole that combines the warmth of corn with a comforting creaminess, perfect for a cozy evening.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Add flour and whisk until smooth; cook for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in milk, whisking constantly to prevent lumps.
Bring to a simmer and cook until thickened, stirring occasionally.
Stir in cheddar cheese until melted.
In a separate bowl, combine corn, cream corn, salt, and pepper.
Pour the sauce over the corn mixture and stir to combine.
Transfer to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with crushed crackers.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.
